description:
Cancel a wallet subscription so the payer is not charged again. Confirm with the user first — a cancel the payer didn't ask for loses a customer, and there are no refunds.

Args:
  - subscription_id: the sub_… id.
  - at_period_end: default true — no more charges, and it ends at current_period_end (the payer keeps what they paid for). You can undo this kind of cancel before then with jami_resume_subscription. false ends it immediately (a past_due subscription always ends immediately).

Returns the updated subscription: { subscription_id, status, cancel_at_period_end, ended_at, cancellation_reason, … }. Idempotent: cancelling twice is harmless.

response_format.description: 'markdown' (default) for a readable summary, 'json' for the full structured payload

subscription_id.description: Subscription id, e.g. "sub_9f2kQ…" from jami_list_subscriptions or a subscription.* webhook

name: jami_cancel_subscription

amount_minor.description: Charged every period, integer santim (locked at approval)

next_charge_at.description: Next renewal or retry; null once canceled or set to end

title: Cancel subscription
